name: Stiiizy | 40's 2.5g Blunt Multi-Pack | Super Lemon Haze
description:
Each STIIIZY 40’s blunt features our premium cannabis flower, infused with expertly crafted live resin. Rolled in 100% tobacco-free, kief-coated hemp wraps, STIIIZY 40’s blunts are crafted for quality and a smooth finish. These blunts represent a high standard in infused cannabis innovation.

Super Lemon Haze is a sativa with a citrus-forward profile and subtle layered undertones.
